subject: english
question: Select the sentence with no spelling errors.

options.text: When placed on the column, each ring slid down to its correct position, if posible.
When placed on the column, each ring slid down to its corect position, if possible.
When placed on the column, each ring slid down to its correct position, if possible.
When placed on the colum, each ring slid down to its correct position, if possible.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"possible"** means something that can be done or achieved, or that can exist. (संभव)

 
 
• **Example: **It is possible to complete the project within the deadline if we work efficiently.
 
 
 
• **"Correct" **refers to something that is free from errors; accurate or true. (सही)
 
 
• **Example: **She gave the correct answer to the question.
 
 
 
• Hence, the sentence with no spelling errors is: **'When placed on the column, each ring slid down to its correct position, if possible.'**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** "Posible" is a misspelling of "possible". (संभव)

 
 
• **Example:** It is not possible to travel faster than the speed of light.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "Corect" is a misspelling of "correct". (सही)
 
 
• **Example:** The corect answer was given by the student. (Incorrect spelling)
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "Colum" is a misspelling of "column". (स्तंभ)
 
 
• **Example:** The data was arranged in a single colum. (Incorrect spelling)
